summary: Russian forces launched coordinated missile and drone attacks across Ukraine, targeting ports, infrastructure, and civilian areas with Iskander-M missiles and Shahed UAVs. Ukraine's air defenses reportedly intercepted 117 hostile drones and missiles, while Russian troops advanced near Riasne in Kharkiv region. High-level Ukrainian personnel changes announced as Zelensky prepares to appoint new intelligence leadership amid escalating strikes on energy infrastructure and commercial facilities.
key_points: Russian missile and drone attacks targeted 14 locations across Ukraine, with 117 hostile UAVs and one Iskander-M missile intercepted or downed (Source: @kpszsu/71450).
Russian forces advanced near Riasne in Kharkiv region, updating the operational map (Source: @DeepStateUA/23718).
Attacks on Ukrainian infrastructure caused civilian casualties including children in Sumy and Mykolaiv (Source: @UkraineNow/83167).
Russian strikes hit four vessels carrying military cargo in Nikolaev port (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32148).
Ukrainian air defenses reported downing 117 Shahed-type drones and missiles across northern, southern, and eastern regions (Source: @kpszsu/71450).
Zelensky announced appointments of Rustem Umerov as Foreign Intelligence Service head and Igor Klymenko to National Security Council (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32143).
Wildberries logistics center in Krasny Bor, Lipetsk region suffered 154,000 m2 fire from Ukrainian drone strike (Source: @eRadarrua/103936).
Russian forces claimed control over Bely Kolodez and Ustinovka in Kharkiv region (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32138).

sections.threat_assessment: Russian forces escalated operations with coordinated Iskander-M missile and Shahed UAV attacks across Ukraine, targeting critical infrastructure and civilian areas. Ukrainian air defenses successfully intercepted 117 hostile drones and missiles, demonstrating improved capabilities but highlighting ongoing vulnerability to precision strikes. Russian territorial advances near Riasne in Kharkiv region suggest potential breakthrough attempts, while attacks on commercial logistics centers like Wildberries indicate targeting of economic infrastructure. The deployment of armored trains on Ukrainian railways signals adaptation to sustained sabotage threats. High-level Ukrainian personnel changes may reflect strategic reorganization amid intensified combat operations.
sections.regional_response: NATO allies continue military aid deliveries to Ukraine despite Russian strikes on energy infrastructure and commercial facilities. Lithuanian education ministry proposed replacing Lomonosov with Shevchenko in curricula, reflecting cultural solidarity measures. Australian defense officials are developing unmanned underwater drone capabilities, indicating regional interest in asymmetric warfare technologies. Russian military experts report daily positional gains in Orekhiv, suggesting potential strategic momentum. International humanitarian organizations face challenges supporting affected populations in Sumy and Mykolaiv regions.
sections.intelligence_notes: Ukrainian SBU operations detected espionage activities including soldier detention for gas station coordinate leaks, indicating active counterintelligence measures. Russian tactical aviation activity increased in northeast direction, threatening rear areas. Automated border information exchange between Ukrainian tax and border services aims to detect violations more effectively. Telegram messaging platform disappeared from app stores in Russia, Turkey, and America, potentially affecting communication channels. Ukrainian defense officials emphasize state survival through multi-domain force balance including military, economic, technological, and spiritual components.
